title: No un-opt operation exists: an opt-out (record id AND stored meeting identity) can never be removed through the API
evidence: router.ts exposes GET, PUT (rules only, state kept), POST approvals, POST opt-outs. Nothing deletes an entry of optedOutEventIds or optedOutMeetings. Before this unit that was already true of ids; the stored identity makes it more visible because it blocks the whole meeting, including every later record of it. Test 'un-opt' in join-rules-optout-meeting.test.ts pins that no delete/patch route exists.
fix_direction: A future un-opt unit (new route or scope: needs the Approver) must remove the id and the matching url:/key: entries together, e.g. by storing the id alongside its entries, or by removing url: and key: entries named in the request.

title: The identity is only stored when the client sends meetingUrl/sessionKey with the opt-out; the web page and any wiring must send them
evidence: POST /calendar/join-rules/opt-outs accepts optional meetingUrl and sessionKey; the router has no calendar access, so it cannot derive them from eventId. A client that sends only eventId (every client today) stores the id alone and the ISS-T037W1-001 hole stays open for that opt-out. Not changed here (apps/web is outside this unit; one package per unit).
fix_direction: The opt-out UI / wiring unit passes the selected record's meetingUrl and sessionKey. W7 of qa/contracts/t037-join-rules-veto-select.md should only be lifted once the opt-out path that production uses sends them.

severity_note: re-rated low->medium by the checker (cycle 0): with no un-opt (ISS-T037OPT-001) the block on a reused room URL is permanent and removable only by hand-editing the tenant file; still tenant-scoped, veto-only, fail-closed
title: Stored identity of a recurring personal room blocks every later meeting on that URL
evidence: meetingIdentity ignores start time by design, so url:zoom:<pmi> is the same for every use of a personal room. Opting out of one occurrence with meetingUrl sent stores that identity and vetoes all later items on that room (removal-only, fail-closed), until an un-opt exists (ISS-T037OPT-001).
fix_direction: Accepted for now; same family as ISS-T037W1-002. If it bites: store identity plus start-time window, or let the client omit meetingUrl for recurring rooms and rely on sessionKey.

regression_check: scripts/webinar/join-rules-host.test.ts: ISS-T037OPT-004 end to end (5/5; 1/5 with the adapter line reverted); verified by checker cycle 1 at 18e58f3
title: The only production deps adapter drops the opt-out hints, so a client that sends meetingUrl/sessionKey still stores the id alone
evidence: scripts/webinar/join-rules-host.ts line 26: `recordOptOut: (t, id) => recordTenantOptOut(stateDir, t, id),` takes two parameters, so the third `meeting` argument the router now passes is discarded. Reproduction: POST /calendar/join-rules/opt-outs {eventId:'calX',meetingUrl:'https://zoom.us/j/123456789'} through createJoinRulesDeps -> 200, state.optedOutMeetings absent; the ISS-T037W1-001 hole stays open end to end. Trap for the fix: recordTenantOptOut's 4th parameter is `opts`, the hint is the 5th, so the adapter must be `(t,id,m)=>recordTenantOptOut(stateDir,t,id,{},m)`; passing m as 4th silently turns it into store options. ISS-T037OPT-002 names only the web client.
fix_direction: Update join-rules-host.ts (and the scripts/qa harness adapter) to forward the hint as the 5th argument, with a test through createJoinRulesDeps asserting optedOutMeetings is persisted. Consider moving `meeting` before `opts` or into one options object so the order cannot be confused.

regression_check: join-rules-optout-identity.test.ts pins M2 and M6; 2/2 mutants killed, 5/5 spellings (startsWith, includes, reverse-prefix, tag-stripped, tag-swapped); verified by checker cycle 1 at 18e58f3
title: Tests do not pin the two properties that bound over-blocking: exact (non-prefix) matching and url:/key: tag separation
evidence: Mutation M2: `rawEntries.includes(w)` -> `rawEntries.some(r => typeof r==='string' && w.startsWith(r))` leaves join-rules-optout-meeting, -identity, join-rules, -store and -select tests green (stored `key:k` would then veto every record whose key begins with k). Mutation M6: comparing entries ignoring the tag (so `key:zoom:123456789` matches a url identity `url:zoom:123456789`) also survives. The current code is correct (checker probes: stored key:zoom:123456789 does not veto a zoom:123456789 URL event; key:url:zoom:999999999 does not match a URL identity; no prefix matching); only the regression pin is missing. Also surviving, low: M9 (url body degenerate check), M10 (approvals route accepting the hint fields), M13 (key trim).
fix_direction: Add tests: stored `key:k1` does not veto key `k10`/`k1x`; stored `url:zoom:123456789` does not veto key `zoom:123456789` and stored `key:zoom:123456789` does not veto the URL event; one prefix case for `url:`.
